outcome: It becomes day or night, and from then on the game has exactly one of the designations.
Day becoming night or night becoming day removes one designation and adds the other.
In the untap step the game checks the previous turn to see whether the designation changes.
If it is day and the previous turn's active player cast no spells, it becomes night.
If it is night and the previous turn's active player cast two or more spells, it becomes day.
If the game is neither day nor night, the check does not happen and it stays neither.
